subject: ela
topic: Making inferences and citing text evidence

lines.label: Set up my agents with my examples

itemRequests.quiz: Please write two short passages of your own from my notes (about 250-350 words each): one story and one nonfiction article. Both versions read the same two passages but get different questions. 8-10 multiple choice questions, mostly inference and 'which evidence best supports' questions, then one short constructed response at the end: What can you infer about the character? Use two pieces of evidence.
itemRequests.rubric: A 4-point rubric for the constructed response (claim, evidence, explanation), in kid-friendly words my students can use to self-check.

requests: My students are 7th graders, many reading a little below grade level, so keep sentences clear. Number the paragraphs in the passages so students can cite them.
